title: Shared Variant Timing Profile — Embodied Stride Repair
revision_intent: Repair Timing fixture 002 without changing its evidence family. Preserve observed left/right preview timing-equivalence as evidence, but replace placeholder abstract gait with a visibly forceful nonuniform authored stride shown simultaneously under two orientation presentations using one shared temporal key list.
thesis: TIMING EQUIVALENCE MAY BE SHARED; PERFORMANCE STILL HAS TO ACT. A non-temporal orientation variant reuses the same temporal keys while anticipation, support break, contact catch, rebound, secondary lag, and exit debt remain visibly embodied.

timing_vocabulary.TWOS: one drawing/key held two display frames
timing_vocabulary.FOURS: one drawing/key held four display frames
timing_vocabulary.street_fighter_capcom: nonuniform authored gameplay timing may mix anticipation holds, fast transitions, contact/impact emphasis, recoil/recovery holds, silhouette exaggeration, and selective sampling; inferred durations are never source-authentic claims.

keys.name: REAR_LOAD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM sits behind the planted rear/left foot line and drops; lead foot hovers one row above ground. Arms oppose the coming drive. Orientation mirror is presentation only.

keys.name: FORWARD_COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM advances and sinks further while the same rear foot stays planted; lead knee/foot reaches forward without stealing support.

keys.name: DRIVE_SNAP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear/left foot is the final support as COM launches forward/up; long opposing arm/leg lines create a one-frame release spike.

keys.name: FLIGHT_EXTENSION
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support is explicitly NONE; COM continues forward/up after the drive. The long split silhouette is not interpolated across the support break.

keys.name: PRECONTACT_REACH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM begins to descend while chest lags behind the reaching lead/right foot; the foot remains one row above ground so contact is not invented early.

keys.name: LEAD_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead/right foot acquires ground in a hard contact key while COM and torso are still traveling; contact is not smoothed through.

keys.name: CATCH_COMPRESSION
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead/right foot stays world-locked while pelvis drops past it; torso folds and rear limbs lag, paying the contact with a deep compression rather than teleporting to recovery.

keys.name: REBOUND_PASS
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM rebounds up and begins passing over the planted lead/right foot; chest leads while rear arm/leg remain delayed.

keys.name: SECONDARY_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body passes the support while the trailing arm and recovering leg arrive late; the planted foot keeps support truthful during secondary lag.

keys.name: EXIT_STRIDE_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM and chest have traveled clearly past the planted right support while the opposite/left foot reaches forward one row above ground; the final silhouette is a falling next-step obligation, not a vertical neutral.

compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS -> SUPPORT-SAFE DETERMINISTIC CURVED BRIDGES -> SIMULTANEOUS ORIENTATION PRESENTATIONS -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SELF-CONTAINED SPA
compile.renderer: Python/Pillow literal ASCII frames; ffmpeg libx264 yuv420p

tango.judgment: PASS on the byte-identical 37-frame current render. The performance establishes a long rear-load boundary, compresses through forward coil into a one-frame drive spike, hard-cuts the support break, decelerates into a readable pre-contact reach, hard-cuts contact acquisition, pays the catch with deep compression and a four-frame consequence hold, then rebounds through delayed limb phase and exits with unresolved forward debt. Same-support bridges curve; support changes never interpolate. Left and right presentation variants share one temporal key list. No equalized spacing, dead terminal hold, reverse interpolation, idle reset, straight-line tweening, or invented support state survives.

noodle_queen.judgment: PASS after Tango on the same render and specimen. TASTE comes from the compact rear-loaded coil against the later long flight/catch silhouettes; FUNCTION is the instantly legible shared timing profile across simultaneous mirrored presentation variants; CONTEMPT is the refusal to neutralize the ending—the body leaves with a next-step obligation. The motion is economical without reading as placeholder.
